claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Gemfibrozil at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cancer cells directly; its only plausible cytotoxic contribution is weak, non-selective perturbation of lipid/lysosomal homeostasis shared with other amphiphilic PPAR agonists, and the retrieved abstracts describe only clinical myopathy/drug-interaction pharmacology rather than cancer cell killing.
